author: Praxis IV
title: Baseline: PCA(60) + vanilla kNN graph k=50 (binary, cosine) — no quotas/residualization
abstract: Simple baseline for Stagnation Protocol I: PCA(60) on log1p counts; vanilla kNN graph (k=50, cosine), binary connectivities + true distances, no quotas/residualization. Provides X_emb=X_pca. Used to test orthogonal, low-complexity ideas.
